summary: For controller LDAP over SSL, create secret bundle-ca-secret from a file named bundle-ca.crt (oc create secret generic), set spec.bundle_cacert_secret, then check /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt in the gateway deployment with openssl x509.
questions: How do I add an LDAP CA certificate on the AAP Operator?
LDAPS certificate verify failed on OpenShift AAP

answer_card.title: LDAP CA bundle on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc create secret -n aap generic bundle-ca-secret --from-file=bundle-ca.crt
```
```yaml
spec:
  bundle_cacert_secret: bundle-ca-secret
```
Verify:
```bash
oc get deployments -l 'app.kubernetes.io/component=aap-gateway'
oc exec -it deployment.apps/<gateway> -- openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt -noout -text
```
